copper mountain.note: YAY SNOW DAY! Copper Mountain received 4 inches of natural snow!!! Weather during the day looks chilly with temps staying under 20 degrees, winds in the 10 mph range with gust as high as 30 mph from the W/NW direction. Snow precipitation will fizzle out by noon with cloudy coverage most of the day. Easy Rider surface lift and associated terrain will open up today, this will be our only beginner terrain! We still have limited trails open, so please stay in boundaries and snow in a matter that is safe for early season. Thank a snowmaker and enjoy some POWDER TURNS! Stay up-to-date with terrain openings by using the Terrain Alerts Channel on the Copper Mountain Instagram.

snowbird.note: Guess what all you skiers & snowboarders? Snowbird is opening early! Wax those boards, waterproof those jackets and get ready to ride. The new Opening Day is Wednesday, November 25. Resort Update: All uphill travel is CLOSED for snowmaking and winter 2026-27 on-mountain preparation. Snowbird is scheduled to open for lift-serviced operations on November 27. Mountain Report: Another 5 inches overnight! Yesterday started out windy but by afternoon the winds had calmed down enough to let our snow-making crews join in on the fun and add some of their own snow to the natural flakes falling. And for all you Season Passholders, today (11/21) is Pre-Season Passholder Appreciation Day! Come on up between 11 am to 2 pm to build some preseason stoke, pick up your season pass and UDOT sticker (we are 100% back in snow tire season) and get your skis or snowboard waxed by our friends at Board Budder . Passholder Appreciation Day details After a day of skiing, spend Thanksgiving at Snowbird . Bring the family, make a reservation and leave the cooking and cleanup to us. And Season Passholders, don't forget about your Early Bird Benefit (Passholder's who bought/renewed by May 13). Your free night at The Cliff Lodge is valid through December 17. The first couple of weekends of ski season are always exciting ones, so get your stay on the books while availability allows. The mountain is white. Snowmaking is underway. Opening Day is getting closer. Give me The Bird
